_source: AQE live export + src/engines/*.py (D-24 spec). One place; AQE conforms to this.

_conventions._convention: LONG setups: STOPS are BELOW entry, TARGETS are ABOVE entry. Values are absolute USD prices unless the name ends in _rr/_ratio/_pct/_ann (ratios) or is a list/object. 'rr'/'r' = reward-to-risk in R, where 1R = bracket.risk (= price \u2212 bracket.stop, the structural risk unit).
_conventions._decision_framework: AQE reads the trade lifecycle in three distinct stages \u2014 do NOT conflate them; each answers a different question, so there is no 'picking at random': (1) DETECT \u2014 is a move brewing? = Signal Radar (runner_setup = a name already moving with another leg; premove_setup = a pre-move, ~12-day lead). These are DETECTION tags, not entries. (2) ENTER \u2014 is it time to buy, and where? = the bracket (stop/targets/R:R) + the live alert engine (buy-zone / breakout / near-stop levels). The PM/AIC pulls the trigger here. (3) HOLD \u2014 should an OPEN position stay on? = Health (hl_score/hl_state, on held_positions ONLY): HOLD_ADD / HOLD / TIGHTEN / EXIT on trend integrity. Readiness (the old rd_* entry-timing composite) is intentionally NOT in this feed \u2014 it overlapped premove_setup + the alert levels, so DETECT and ENTER already cover entry timing. AQE makes NO decision at any stage; it supplies the data and levels, the AIC decides.

atr_14d.definition: 14-day Average True Range in USD (the volatility unit).

atr_caution.definition: True if the structural stop was too tight for the regime (risk% near the regime ceiling).

beta_30d.definition: 30-day beta vs SPY \u2014 the portfolio-gate window (D-6).
beta_30d.method: 30-day beta vs SPY (the gate window, D-6).

bracket.definition: THE bracket \u2014 the single source of truth for stop + targets (mechanical DSL/TP is retired). A nested object: {price, price_source (eod_close on the daily run / live_15min on a live pull), stop, stop_type (swing_low/ma/fib that the stop sits on), stop_atr_dist (risk in ATRs \u2014 read this, not raw USD), risk (=price\u2212stop, the R unit to size against), risk_pct, targets[{type,tp (TP1/2/3),price,r,atr_dist}] (structural resistance/MA/fib ABOVE price, nearest-first \u2014 TAKE PROFIT against these), rr (R:R to the structural TP2), rr_tp1/rr_tp2/rr_tp3 (R:R to each of the first three targets), atr_fallback_stop (= 1\u00d7ATR below price \u2014 the reference stop when valid=false, i.e. no structural level exists today), valid, invalid_reason}. PM RULING R1 (2026-08-14): THE BRACKET IS NEVER A GATE. It is PRE-ENTRY information the PM reviews via the bracket skill, which the PM activates. valid=false means only that the engine found no structural level at today's close \u2014 report it as context if read, and NEVER let it block, veto, downgrade, filter or discourage a nomination, a shortlist place, or a deliberation verdict. Analysis of the NAME and analysis of the ENTRY are separate steps; the PM owns the entry step. STOP is below price, TARGETS above; R and ATR distances are relative, not absolute noise. VOLUME VALIDATION: dated levels carry vol_ratio (pivot-bar volume / trailing 20-bar avg) + vol_validated (ratio \u2265 1.2) \u2014 a level DEFENDED on high volume is a stronger level; the stop's own read is stop_date + stop_vol_ratio + stop_vol_validated (present when the stop is swing-based). Data only, at every stage of the committee.
bracket.method: bracket_engine.py: structural single-source bracket (stop/targets), volume-validated. valid=false = no structural level found \u2014 information for the PM's bracket-skill review, never a gate (PM ruling R1, 2026-08-14).

choch_date.definition: Date of the latest CHoCH event (null when choch_state=NONE).

choch_state.definition: Change-of-Character (swing-break trend flip), the LATEST detected event: BULLISH = close broke above the last confirmed swing high while the prior trend was flat/down; BEARISH mirrors it (broke below swing low). NONE = no CHoCH detected. Non-repainting (confirmed pivots only).

div_bear_count.definition: How many of the 5 oscillators confirm the bearish divergence (0-5).

div_bull_count.definition: How many of the 5 oscillators confirm the bullish divergence (0-5). More confirming oscillators = stronger read.

div_date.definition: Date of the confirming (newer) pivot anchoring the divergence.

div_oscs.definition: Which oscillators fired, comma-joined \u2014 bullish names bare, bearish names prefixed '-' (e.g. 'rsi,mfi,-obv'). Null when none.

div_state.definition: Regular price-vs-oscillator DIVERGENCE at the last close (non-repainting: confirmed pivots only, freshness-gated ~10 bars): BULLISH = price made a lower pivot low while \u22651 oscillator made a higher low (downmove losing internal energy); BEARISH mirror on highs; MIXED = both; NONE. Oscillators tested: RSI, MFI, CMF, MACD, OBV \u2014 all AQE-computed. Context only, never a gate.
div_state.method: divergence.py: regular divergence price vs 5 oscillators at confirmed pivots.

elder_5d.definition: Elder impulse read over a 5-day context (list of recent impulse states).

elder_context.definition: Hourly VWAP/VCP/exhaustion context object behind the elder read (elder_context.py).

energy.definition: Energy engine [0,100] (energy.py): range-position proxy + price-action + squeeze + exhaustion + ATR.
energy.method: energy.py: [0,100] range-position proxy + price-action + squeeze + exhaustion + ATR.

entry.definition: Reference entry = prior close-of-day. The live fill is the IBKR price at bracket time, NOT this value.

fib_swing_high.definition: Upper anchor (swing high) of the Fibonacci retracement.
fib_swing_high.method: upper anchor of the fib swing.

fib_swing_low.definition: Lower anchor (swing low) of the Fibonacci retracement.
fib_swing_low.method: lower anchor of the fib swing.

fip_spike_excluded.definition: UNDOCUMENTED \u2014 AQE owner to define (FIP spike-exclusion flag; confirm semantics).

fip_window_effective.definition: UNDOCUMENTED \u2014 AQE owner to define (effective FIP window; confirm semantics).

floor.definition: UNDOCUMENTED \u2014 AQE owner to define (meaning not recoverable from code comments).

flow.definition: Flow engine [0,100] (flow.py): MFI+CMF+Heikin-Ashi quality + A/D linreg + volume trend/spike + up/down skew.
flow.method: flow.py: [0,100] = MFI+CMF+Heikin-Ashi quality + A/D linreg + volume trend/spike + up/down skew.

gics_sector.definition: GICS sector ETF code the name maps to.

in_ledger.definition: Flag: name is currently tracked in the nomination ledger.
in_ledger.method: flag: currently tracked in the nomination ledger.

inside_bar.definition: True if the LAST bar's range is fully inside the PRIOR bar's range (high < prev_high AND low > prev_low) \u2014 a one-bar consolidation pause.

knn_neighbors_used.definition: How many historical analog events the knn_prob is averaged over (0 if none found).

knn_prob.definition: K-NEAREST-NEIGHBORS directional probability (0-1) for the current CHoCH: the win-rate of the K most similar HISTORICAL CHoCH events on this SAME ticker (matched on 3 features \u2014 volume-delta, ATR-normalised displacement, velocity \u2014 via Euclidean distance), where 'win' = the move's max favorable excursion exceeded its max adverse excursion within a fixed lookahead. This IS genuine instance-based learning (a real kNN), not a black box \u2014 but it's simple (3 hand-picked features, no training beyond the ticker's own history) and should be read as one more context signal, not a probability of profit. Null when there's no CHoCH or too few historical analogs to query.
knn_prob.method: smart_money_knn.py: kNN over ticker's own CHoCH history \u2192 directional probability.

knn_threshold_clear.definition: True iff knn_prob clears a fixed threshold in either direction (\u226560% or \u226440% by default). CAVEAT (AIC Charter Amendment v2.8, 2026-07-15 ruling): this is a plain threshold check on a SMALL neighbor count (k=5 by default), NOT a statistical significance test \u2014 at k=5, 3-of-5 agreeing clears the 60% bar trivially, including by chance. Carries no p-value or confidence-interval semantics. Read as 'the threshold was crossed', not 'the analogs meaningfully agree'.
knn_threshold_clear.method: smart_money_knn.py: threshold flag (NOT a significance test).

knn_tp1.definition: Nearest kNN-implied target (USD): current price \u00b1 half the neighbors' mean favorable excursion, signed by the CHoCH direction. A statistical projection from historical analogs, NOT a structural level \u2014 read alongside bracket.targets, never in place of them.

knn_tp2.definition: Mid kNN-implied target: current price \u00b1 the neighbors' MEDIAN favorable excursion, signed by direction.

knn_tp3.definition: Far kNN-implied target: current price \u00b1 the neighbors' 75th-percentile favorable excursion, signed by direction.

lens.definition: Per-lens read: strong/ok/warn/-- for leadership, coil, insti_money, structure, resistance, sector. `extension` is ALWAYS null \u2014 the voices disagree on what extension means, so AQE prints the numbers (subcomponents.flow.ext_score, energy.en_pos50/exhaustion_score/atr_score) and makes no call. Every verdict comes from a label AQE already computes, or from top/bottom-third position in TODAY's list. No fitted thresholds anywhere. '--' = no data; absence is never agreement.

lens_positive.definition: Count of lenses reading `strong` (0-6). UNWEIGHTED \u2014 no weighting was ever earned. Sort on it to tier the read; it is a READING AID, not a prediction, and whether 5-of-6 beats 2-of-6 is untested. Never a gate: nothing is eliminated, every name keeps its full block.
lens_positive.method: lens_consensus.py: count of lenses reading positive.

ma_20.method: N-day simple moving average of close.

malformed_bracket.definition: True if the structural stop sits within 0.5% of price (bracket unusable \u2014 stop virtually at entry).

mover_subtype.definition: DETECTION sub-type label (explosive / trend / tight_base / squeeze) \u2014 the family whose z-score profile the name matches best (M16c). Context only; not a gate.

mp_accel.definition: Momentum ACCELERATION (2nd derivative): 5-bar change of the MP momentum z-score (roc_zscore), smoothed 3 bars. Positive = momentum itself is building; negative = rolling over. Flags inflection BEFORE the level/mp_state confirms \u2014 read alongside mp_state (which is a knife-edge when the score plateaus). Additive diagnostic, not part of the Pine spec.
mp_accel.method: mp.py: 2nd derivative \u2014 5-bar change of MP roc z-score.

mp_accel_state.definition: Label for mp_accel with a \u00b10.10 dead-zone: ACCELERATING / DECELERATING / FLAT.

on_elder.definition: Flag: name is on the Elder list.

on_longlist.definition: Flag: name is on the longlist.

pib_pattern.definition: True if the SECOND-TO-LAST bar was a pin bar AND the last bar is an inside bar relative to it \u2014 the 'rejection, then pause' combo pattern. Independent of pin_bar_state (which only reads the LAST bar itself).

pin_bar_date.definition: Date of the pin bar (null when pin_bar_state=NONE).

pin_bar_level.definition: The pin bar's rejection extreme (USD): the LOW for a bullish pin (a candidate support), the HIGH for a bearish pin (candidate resistance). Null when pin_bar_state=NONE.

pin_bar_state.definition: Candlestick REJECTION pattern on the LAST closed bar (pure geometry, no lookahead): BULLISH_PIN = long lower wick (\u226566% of range) + small body (\u226440%) + small upper wick (\u226440%) \u2014 the market pushed down and got rejected; BEARISH_PIN mirrors it (long upper wick). NONE = no pattern. Filtered so the bar's range must be \u22652\u00d7 the prior bar's range (rejects 'pin bars' that are just noise inside an already-tiny range).
pin_bar_state.method: pin_bar.py: pin/inside-bar candlestick geometry on last bar.

premove_conviction.definition: DETECTION conviction (0-4): count of M18 launcher-fingerprint legs present. Context only; not a probability of profit.

premove_conviction_label.definition: Human-readable pre-move conviction = word + number, e.g. 'HIGH (3/4)' (MINIMAL 0 / LOW 1 / MODERATE 2 / HIGH 3 / MAX 4). Read this, not the bare number. Detection tag, not a win rate, not sizing.

premove_setup.definition: DETECTION tag (bool): name is QUIET now but coiled to launch \u2014 very young base + squeeze on + well below the recent high (M18 rule, applies only to quiet-pond names). Historical launches came a median ~12 trading days after the tag \u2014 a pre-move radar, not a same-day trigger. NOT a gate, NOT sizing; % elsewhere = detection rate, not win rate.

ptrs.definition: = SC_MOMENTUM verbatim (PM ruling: the Sector-Health adjustment is DROPPED \u2014 sector context is read separately and qualitatively via `srm`/RRG, not double-counted into a per-ticker score). Disposition/sizing is the committee's call \u2014 AQE exports no sizing.

rank.definition: Overall daily rank of the name in the scored universe.

rs_down_day_20d.definition: All-weather leadership: stock's avg outperformance vs SPY on SPY DOWN days (last 20 sessions). Positive = beats SPY when market drops = genuine leader (pct).

rs_leadership.definition: Classification from rs_down_day_20d: LEADER (>+0.25), IN-LINE, LAGGARD (<\u22120.25).

runner_conviction.definition: DETECTION conviction (0-4): how many of the four M15 legs (short base / strong 5d momentum / clear overhead / room below the 20d high) are in their favourable tercile. Higher = stronger historical detection, not a probability of profit.

runner_conviction_label.definition: Human-readable conviction = word + number, e.g. 'HIGH (3/4)'. The word is anchored to the historical +20%/20d detection ladder (MINIMAL 0 / LOW 1 / MODERATE 2 / HIGH 3 / MAX 4 ~= 5/13/27/43% detection). Read this, not the bare number. Still a detection tag, not a win rate, not sizing.

runner_setup.definition: DETECTION tag (bool): name is already moving with another leg \u2014 short young base + strong 5-day thrust + clear overhead (M15 rule). NOT a gate, NOT sizing; the PM decides entry/bracket/size live. Any % reported for this tag elsewhere is a DETECTION RATE (how often tagged names historically touched a level, price-path only) \u2014 never a win rate.

day_vol.definition: (formerly `rvol`) The day's volume over the name's own prior 20-day average; >1 = above-normal participation.
day_vol.method: drive_sync._compute_v21_lookups: today's volume / mean of the prior 20 sessions' volume. Renamed rvol -> day_vol on 2026-08-05; same number, same formula.

sc_m_gate_detail.definition: Per-engine SC_MOMENTUM gate pass/fail (dict): {flow, energy, structure, mp, elder} each True/False vs the SC_M_GATES threshold \u2014 so you read WHICH check a name is failing without recomputing. false = that engine is below its floor.

sc_m_gates.definition: SC_MOMENTUM qualification gate (bool): True iff EVERY engine floor passes \u2014 Flow\u226560, Energy\u226560, Structure\u226555, MP\u226555, Elder\u22656.5 (Pine SC_M_GATES). It does NOT cap the score (composite is uncapped); it flags whether the momentum read is fully gated. See sc_m_gate_detail for which specific check fails.

sc_momentum.definition: SC_MOMENTUM composite [0,100], uncapped weighted average of flow/energy/structure/mp/elder (scoring.py v1.8.0); floors not applied to the composite, Elder gate enforced at qualification.
sc_momentum.method: scoring.py: uncapped weighted composite [0,100] of flow/energy/structure/mp/elder; floors not applied to composite; Elder gate at qualification.

sc_momentum_raw.definition: The ungated SC_MOMENTUM weighted average (== sc_momentum in v1.8.0).
sc_momentum_raw.method: scoring.py: the ungated SC_MOMENTUM weighted average.

sc_p_gate_detail.definition: Per-engine SC_POSITION gate pass/fail (dict): {flow, energy, structure, mp, bq, k39} each True/False vs the SC_P_GATES threshold (k39 = the weekly confirmation gate; null if unavailable).

sc_p_gates.definition: SC_POSITION qualification gate (bool): True iff every engine floor passes \u2014 Flow\u226540, Energy\u226560, Structure\u226565, MP\u226540, BQ\u226560 (Pine SC_P_GATES) AND the K39 weekly gate. Does NOT cap the score. See sc_p_gate_detail for the breakdown.

sector_rrg_direction.definition: The ticker's sector RRG direction of travel: ENTERING / DEEPENING / EXITING / STABLE.

sector_rrg_quadrant.definition: The ticker's sector RRG quadrant vs SPY: LEADING / IMPROVING / WEAKENING / LAGGING.
sector_rrg_quadrant.method: srm.py: RRG quadrant of the sector.

sector_trend_state.definition: The ticker's GICS-sector SRM trend-state for the day (e.g. 'Momentum Building \u2014 Add' / 'Momentum Fading \u2014 Hold' / 'Recovering' / 'Declining'). Context; the gate is gics_gate, unchanged.
sector_trend_state.method: srm.py: sector ETF grade DEPLOY/HOLD/TURNING/WATCH/AVOID \u2192 SH.
enum: Recovering From Weakness \u2014 Watch for Entry

sma_distance_pct.definition: Percent distance of price from its SMA \u2014 extension (large + = extended, ~0 = at support).

structure_shift.definition: BOS/CHoCH read vs the CONFIRMED anchors (data only, never a gate): BULLISH_BOS = COB close broke ABOVE the nearest CONFIRMED pivot high (break of structure \u2014 trend continuation/ignition); BEARISH_CHOCH = close broke BELOW the up-swing's anchor low (character change \u2014 the up-structure failed); RANGE = inside the swing. Null when no swing is detected. (Fixed 2026-07-16, AIC ruling FIX_CONFIRMED_PIVOT: the bullish test previously compared against the current swing's window-max high, which always includes today's own bar \u2014 making BULLISH_BOS mathematically unreachable. Now compares against the nearest confirmed pivot high instead.)
structure_shift.method: structure/smart_money: BOS/CHoCH vs confirmed anchors (data only).

structure_shift_ref.definition: The level the shift is measured against (USD): the broken confirmed pivot high for BULLISH_BOS, the broken swing anchor low for BEARISH_CHOCH; null for RANGE.

subcomponents.definition: The engine SUB-SCORES behind each headline read \u2014 nested by engine, so the AIC sees WHY an engine scored what it did (context, never a gate). flow: {flow_score (MFI+CMF+HA core), accum_score, volume_score, skew_score, ext_score (extension penalty), mfi, cmf, ha_quality_count}. energy: {vp_position_score (volume-profile position), price_action_score, squeeze_score (BB/KC squeeze \u2014 the TTM-squeeze read), exhaustion_score, atr_score, en_pos50, en_trend_bars}. structure: {rs_spy_score, rs_accel_score, base_score, ms_pos_score (market structure), resist_score (overhead), wk_score (weekly trend = HTF bias), earn_score, rs_vs_spy (raw), rs_accel (raw), base_days, bd_mode}. mp: {abs_mom_score, mp_adx_score, rel_mom_score, trend_score, roc_zscore (momentum z), excess_return (vs SPY %), adx_val, di_bullish}. bq: {bq_range_tight, bq_vol_dry, bq_base_dur, bq_ema_conv, bq_base_days}. pipe: {pr_ret_12m, pr_adx_score, pr_rsi_score, pr_vol_score, pr_ma_score (MA-stack alignment), momentum_composite, pipe_tier}. Readiness sub-scores are intentionally NOT here (hidden per the decision-framework ruling) and Health sub-scores stay held-only/dropped.

thematic_basket.definition: Thematic basket the name belongs to (srm thematic layer).

thematic_baskets.definition: All thematic baskets the name belongs to.
thematic_baskets.method: all thematic baskets the name belongs to.

thematic_grade.definition: Grade of the name's thematic basket (see enum).

thematic_parent_gics.definition: Parent GICS sector of the thematic basket.
thematic_parent_gics.method: parent GICS of the thematic basket.

thematic_parent_grade.definition: Grade of the parent GICS sector.

thematic_rrg_direction.definition: The ticker's PRIMARY thematic basket's RRG direction (ENTERING / DEEPENING / EXITING / STABLE).

thematic_rrg_quadrant.definition: The ticker's PRIMARY thematic basket's RRG quadrant vs SPY (LEADING / IMPROVING / WEAKENING / LAGGING).

vol_30d_ann.definition: 30-day annualised realised volatility (decimal: 0.18 = 18%). This IS the Charter \u00a74.5 operative sizing vol (the charter calls it 'vol_30d'; AQE's field is annualised \u2014 same number). Forsizing/VaR, not a target.

bq.definition: Base-quality engine \u2014 measures how tight and mature a consolidation is (bq.py).
bq.method: bq.py: composites base duration, range tightness, volatility dry-up and EMA convergence into a base-quality read.

bq.bq_base_dur.definition: Base duration in days \u2014 how long the current consolidation/base has held (longer, tighter bases are higher quality; feeds the tight_base quality flag).
bq.bq_base_dur.method: bq.py: count of bars in the identified base window.

bq.bq_range_tight.definition: Range-tightness score of the base \u2014 higher = tighter price range within the base (volatility contraction; paired with base duration for the tight_base flag).
bq.bq_range_tight.method: bq.py: inverse of normalized high-low range across the base window, scaled.
